items.title: Schalke 04 snoept Bayern punten af in eerste thuisduel sinds promotie
items.summary: Schalke 04 heeft bij het eerste thuisduel in de Bundesliga direct punten afgesnoept van Bayern München. Het betekent het eerste punt voor Die Königsblauen sinds de terugkeer op het hoogste niveau.

items.title: High-flying Hull maintain unbeaten start by holding off Aston Villa in stalemate
items.summary: It’s never dull in Hull, as the saying goes in these parts, and after just three games the Premier League is proving to be quite some ride for Hull City supporters. Having embarrassed Manchester United here on the opening day and won at Coventry last weekend, this deserved point and clean sheet will have reinforced Sergej Jakirovic’s belief that his men can beat the drop. items.summary: De eerste topper in de Serie A heeft een spectaculaire zege voor Internazionale opgeleverd. De Milanezen waren Napoli de baas dankzij een heel vruchtbare slotfase.

items.title: Fernandez and Ndiaye show signs of promise on Man City debuts
items.summary: Manchester City gave £185m of deadline-day talent their Premier League debuts in the win over Coventry - and manager Enzo Maresca will have enjoyed what he saw.

items.title: Glasner claims VAR was ‘guessing’ after Forest are denied winner against Spurs
items.summary: Oliver Glasner argued there was insufficient evidence to disallow Neco Williams’s goal against Tottenham, accusing the video assistant referee Peter Bankes of guessing that the Nottingham Forest defender handled and said ruling it out weakens the officials’ authority. Midway through the second half, Williams stooped to head in on the goalline as Sandro Tonali attempted to hook the ball clear after Morgan Gibbs-White’s deflected effort bobbled towards the net. Glasner conceded at least one angle showed Williams appeared to handle the ball, seemingly to protect himself as Tonali went to clear the ball with his left boot, but said the footage was too unclear to disallow the goal. “I don’t think VAR can intervene when he’s guessing,” said Forest’s head coach. “It was not clear and obvious. We had a briefing before the season that the threshold for VAR intervention should be very high and this is why it was a wrong intervention for me. Continue reading...

items.title: 'Not Football Manager' - De Zerbi says misfiring Spurs need time
items.summary: Tottenham have failed to score in their opening three Premier League games and manager Roberto de Zerbi says it will take time to build his expensive squad into a team.

items.title: Pompey boss apologises as Cardiff's Bielik clashes with fan
items.summary: Portsmouth head coach John Mousinho apologises to Cardiff City players after an incident involving home fans at Fratton Park during their Championship match.

items.title: Enzo Le Fée penalty redemption rescues point for Sunderland at Brentford
items.summary: True redemption, perhaps, would have been to score with a Panenka, but Enzo Le Fée didn’t quite have the chutzpah for that. His duffed dink at Brentford in January was the low point of one of Sunderland’s two worst performances of the season, but he converted from the spot with eight minutes remaining to earn a draw in a battle of two physically aggressive and well-drilled teams who must both look at the chaos elsewhere and be thinking again of top-half finishes. It had seemed that it would be a tale of Brentford’s newfound strength in depth and a second-half turnaround as they overcame a rocky first period to have the better of the second after a triple change at half-time, having already lost their captain Nathan Collins to a calf strain. But instead it was a Sunderland substitute who made the key contribution, Wilson Isidor being held by Keane Lewis-Potter at the back post to earn the penalty. Continue reading...

items.title: Chilwell seals Crystal Palace comeback win after Mitchell double at Fulham
items.summary: The managers may have changed but the result stays the same. For the fourth successive trip to this part of west London, Crystal Palace returned over the river with a win as Pierre Sage got his reign off the mark in dramatic style. Their hero was Ben Chilwell, the former England left-back who was signed on deadline day from Strasbourg – this time permanently, after a loan spell in which he helped Palace win the FA Cup – after he came off the bench to volley home the winner. It was a bitter blow to take for Fulham’s new manager Álvaro Arbeloa, who had seen his side lead twice through the impressive Josh King – who showed his real potential in front of the watching England manager, Thomas Tuchel – and César Palacios before being pegged back twice by Tyrick Mitchell, the second in a moment of pure slapstick. Arbeloa and his side left the pitch to boos from some supporters and remain pointless after three matches. But having won here three times in 2025 under Oliver Glasner, this has been a happy hunting ground for Palace and Chilwell could not contain his delight as he celebrated with Sage and the travelling fans at the full-time whistle. Continue reading...

items.title: Haaland edges Manchester City past Coventry as Fernández sparkles on debut
items.summary: Enzo Fernández started for Manchester City after Nico O’Reilly’s back injury during the warm-up and sparkled, showing why the club paid a British record-equalling £125m for the midfielder. The winner came courtesy of Erling Haaland’s 300th goal in club football and Fernández had a key part, feeding Antoine Semenyo, whose cross from the right was crashed home. In the second half Coventry hammered away, but their wait for a first top-flight goal since Mustapha Hadji’s second in a 3-2 defeat at Aston Villa on 5 May 2001 goes on. The visitors did not like losing, but were heartened by holding the star-studded hosts to a slender win, though the bottom line is all three of their Premier League outings on their return have been defeats. Continue reading...

items.title: LIVE : le Standard met d'emblée la pression sur l'Antwerp

Les Rouches veulent signer un cinquième match sans défaite et une troisième victoire de rang, tandis que les Anversois veulent se remettre de leur défaite 1-4 concédée la semaine dernière contre Saint-Trond. items.title: Loïs Openda retrouve ses sensations après la déception de Turin : "Ce n'était pas une bonne période"

items.title: Supporters woest na match tegen Club Brugge: Lommel komt met verontschuldigingen

Bij Malinwa zijn de feiten echter alleen nog maar groter geworden. Westerlo heeft de eerste driepunter van het seizoen beet en behaalde die in stijl.

items.title: Il était proche des Diables : un Gantois fait son retour après 252 jours loin des terrains

items.title: La réception de Genk sera un gros test : Vitor Bruno, cette fois, doit changer quelque chose
